issues: Hair is predominantly loose and center-parted; adding a two-braid reference would improve hairstyle separation for Zeinab, though the existing headwear image provides useful variation.

summary: The anchor convincingly depicts a childlike 12-year-old Egyptian village girl with the required round face, large dark eyes, strong brows, long black hair and visible front-tooth gap. It is photorealistic, anatomically sound and period-plausible. The training set maintains identity across expressions, angles, lighting, framing, outfits and action, with no clear facial drift, artifacts, prohibited text or modern objects.
name: Malak Samy
